title: Battle of Cannae
summary: Hannibal encircled and destroyed a much larger Roman army at Cannae in Apulia. Tens of thousands of Romans died in a single day.
reason: Rome sought a decisive battle to end Hannibal's campaign in Italy and sent an exceptionally large army against him.
significance: Its double envelopment became a classic of military tactics, studied for more than two thousand years.
